Summary: Create Jira site and PEER Scrum project
Description:
Free plan, site peerlytics, Scrum project Peerlytics with key PEER, invite the four builders, columns To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done.

Done when: the board has the four columns and all members are invited

Summary: Create sprints and epics in Jira
Description:
One sprint per phase with the dates and goals from the guide, and the 17 epics.

Done when: all six sprints and 17 epics exist

Summary: Connect GitHub for Jira and add the merge automation
Description:
Install GitHub for Jira, connect the repo, and add one rule: pull request merged moves the linked issue to Done.

Done when: a PR titled PEER-1 Test link shows in the Development panel of PEER-1, and merging moves it to Done

Summary: Branch protection for develop and main
Description:
Run scripts/setup-github.sh: require a PR, 1 approval and the CI and Jira-key checks. Only Sangay merges to main and creates v* tags.

Done when: a direct push to main or develop is refused, and a PR needs the checks plus an approval

staging deploys from develop. production deploys from v* tags with Sangay as required reviewer.

Done when: both environments exist and production asks Sangay to approve

Summary: Add GitHub Actions secrets and connect Snyk
Description:
Add every secret in the Reference table of the guide. Create the Snyk account and import the repo.

Done when: gh secret list shows all secrets and Snyk shows the repo

Run /init, then append the Peerlytics rules block from the guide.

Done when: CLAUDE.md is merged

Prompt S1: what exists, problems, and done, partly done or missing for each feature. No code changes.

Done when: docs/audit.md is merged and the team has read it

Prompt S2: jira-import.csv with one row per step, then import it with the Jira CSV importer.

Done when: every step is an issue in the right sprint and epic

Add Google sign-in with Firebase Auth next to email sign-in.

Done when: a student signs in with Google and lands on My courses

Summary: Four roles with Firebase custom claims
Description:
superAdmin, collegeAdmin, lecturer and student as custom claims. Users can no longer set their own role (audit problem 1).

Done when: each role sees only its own screens and a student cannot make themselves a lecturer

Summary: Backend checks the Firebase ID token on every request
Description:
Express middleware verifies the ID token and role on every route except /health (audit problem 4).

Done when: requests without a valid token get 401 and tests cover each role

Move auto-submit from the browser to the server so it happens even when no tab is open.

Done when: an assignment is submitted at its deadline with every browser closed

Tables: colleges, courses, enrolments, assignments, submissions, analysis_results, grades, overrides, audit_log.

Done when: migrations run on a fresh database and integration tests use a real PostgreSQL

A database trigger blocks UPDATE and DELETE on analysis_results.

Done when: an UPDATE or DELETE fails and a test proves it

Course page with Overview (announcements), Assignments, Groups, Members and Grades.

Done when: a lecturer creates a course and students see all five tabs

Summary: Join a course with a join code
Description:
Students join with a code or an invite.

Done when: a student enters a code and appears in Members

Summary: OpenAI analysis with Hugging Face and VWT fallback
Description:
The backend uses OpenAI for AI likelihood, writing quality, difficulty and feedback. The ai_provider flag switches to Hugging Face and VWT.

Done when: both providers work behind the flag and tests stub them

Store each analysis once in analysis_results. Students can no longer edit reports (audit problem 2).

Done when: a student cannot change a report after submitting

Groups create and assign tasks. The Tasks score is the share of the tasks of a student done by the deadline (audit problem 6).

Done when: the Tasks score comes from real task data

The lecturer sets Time, Edits, Writing and Tasks weights (default 0.25 each). Grading runs on the server (audit problem 3).

Done when: changing the weights changes the suggested grade and tests cover it

Export the grades and overrides of a course to CSV.

Done when: the CSV opens in a spreadsheet with one row per student

Export a report as XML with an XSLT stylesheet.

Done when: the XML renders as a styled report in a browser

Summary: Real-time co-editing with Yjs and Hocuspocus
Description:
collab/ server with Hocuspocus. TipTap uses Yjs, behind a feature flag.

Done when: two browsers edit the same document live without losing text

Each tab is its own XmlFragment in the Yjs document, behind a feature flag.

Done when: a user adds, renames and nests tabs and others see them live

Zod for request bodies, Ajv for external results and tracking events, rate limits, and a Firestore rules review.

Done when: invalid input gets 400 and the security problems in the audit are closed

collegeAdmin manages lecturers and courses for their college.

Done when: a college admin adds a lecturer who can then create courses

Licence limits per college and a usage view, behind a feature flag.

Done when: usage counts are shown and limits are enforced

Only allowed college email domains can sign up.

Done when: an address from another domain is refused

Snyk for packages, code, Docker images and Kubernetes files in security.yml.

Done when: the scan runs on every PR and high issues fail it

Edits made offline sync when back online, behind a feature flag.

Done when: text typed offline appears for others after reconnecting

The lecturer uploads a CSV of student emails to invite, behind a feature flag.

Done when: everyone in the CSV gets an invite

The lecturer splits enrolled students into random groups of a chosen size.

Done when: groups are created with no student left out

notifier/ sends deadline and grade push notifications, behind a feature flag.

Done when: a student gets a push before a deadline

Consistent spacing, empty states, loading and error states.

Done when: no screen shows raw errors or blank areas

docs/privacy-notice.md and an in-app page: what is tracked (time, counts, paste events, versions) and what is not.

Done when: the notice is linked from sign-up and matches what the code records

The lecturer grants an extension to a student or group.

Done when: an extended student is not auto-submitted at the original deadline

The lecturer comments on parts of a submitted document.

Done when: the student sees comments anchored to their text

Lecturer overview of submissions, grades and flags for a course.

Done when: a lecturer sees the status of every group on one page

Students rate the contribution of their group members.

Done when: ratings are collected and shown to the lecturer

Export a document to .docx, behind a feature flag.

Done when: the file opens in Word with headings and formatting intact

E2E tests for sign-in, submit and grade override.

Done when: E2E tests run in CI and pass

Kubernetes manifests and deploy-staging.yml. develop deploys to staging.

Done when: merging to develop updates staging automatically

Every advanced feature reads its flag from Firebase Remote Config.

Done when: turning a flag off hides the feature without a deploy

Tag v1.0. The production workflow deploys after Sangay approves.

Done when: v1.0 is live in production

Metrics, dashboards and alert emails.

Done when: an alert email arrives when the API is down

Status page for the website and the API.

Done when: the status page is public and shows both services

Restore PostgreSQL and Firestore from backup to a test environment.

Done when: the restored data matches and the steps are written down

The report, which says Claude Code was used, and the slides.

Done when: the report is submitted and the presentation is rehearsed
